response.original_title: 僕のヒーローアカデミア THE MOVIE ユアネクスト《A PIECE OF CAKE》
response.overview: During Class 1-A's Quirk training, in preparation to hunt down the remaining members of the League of Villains and the Paranormal Liberation Front, Mina asks Izuku if it's confusing to manage six other Quirks while using One For All. Izuku says it is, but that aspect's manageable thanks to the Sixth User's advice to visualize all of them as tools being swapped around. For fun, Izuku wrote in a journal some hypotheticals in regard to this mindset applying to his classmates' Quirks and how they could interact with one another in team-up scenarios.
response.title: My Hero Academia: You're Next - A Piece of Cake
